messages:
Maya: Noticing a small but growing support queue where customers flip a scope toggle in the console but the live routing doesn't change. Looks like precedence rules are surprising folks.
Alex: Can you give an example?
Maya: Sure: org default sets `route_selector: region-prefer` and a project-level form flips to `route_selector: cost-prefer`. Console shows the form value immediately but runtime keeps region-prefer because project is not allowed to override unless `anchor=true`.
Priya: We intentionally made some fields anchor-only for safety, but the UI shouldn't imply immediate effect.
Maya: Agreed. My proposal: a small "shadow-eval" endpoint that the console can call to compute the exact applied value for a scope without mutating anything. Then the UI can show a diff: "Displayed: cost-prefer (will be ignored) -> Applied: region-prefer" with an action to "Anchor this field for the project".
Zhen: Shadow-eval is basically a pure evaluator — no writes. We can reuse the existing resolver code but need to ensure performance for many concurrent console users. Caching by (scope, base_config_sha) seems required.
Alex: Also add a field-level reason: e.g. `applied_from: default` vs `pinned_by: org-admin` so users understand why.
Priya: Telemetry items: emit `config.shadow_eval` (request/response) and `config.ui_mismatch` when the console-form differs from applied. Include tags: field_name, org_id, project_id, experiment_bucket.
Maya: We should sample the telemetry (1% globally, 100% for canary orgs). Add a Grafana panel showing `ui_mismatch` rate and a simple alert if >50 mismatches/hour for an org.
Alex: For UI: show a subtle pill next to the field: green if effective == displayed, yellow if displayed differs but can be anchored, red if displayed differs and cannot be anchored. Hover shows concise explanation and a link to docs.
Priya: For anchoring flow: clicking "Anchor" should open a confirm modal that explains scope implications and require a short justification. That justification becomes part of the audit log.
Zhen: Backend API shape idea: POST /v1/configs/evaluate with body `{ "scope": "project:123", "candidate": { ... }, "simulate_anchor": true|false }` Response returns evaluated config map and provenance per-field. Keep it simple JSON map.
Alex: Important: keep evaluate API idempotent and side-effect-free so it works for on-prem. Priya: Also avoid leaking secrets in the preview response. Strip any KMS or secret refs.
Maya: Rollout plan: feature flag `shadow_eval_console` enabled for internal orgs -> 5% customer orgs -> 25% -> full. Monitor `ui_mismatch` and support tickets.
Priya: Ops-bot, can we have deploy started + finished messages when the evaluator goes out to staging/canary?
ops-bot: ci-bot: shadow-eval service build started at 2024-05-20T09:12:00Z  build id se-4521
ops-bot: deploybot: shadow-eval canary deploy to eng-platform-canary at 2024-05-20T09:27:14Z  deploy id se-dpl-987
Zhen: Dev questions: should the console hit evaluate on every keystroke? Probably not. Debounce to 1s and use cached results for identical payloads.
Alex: Also we need to rate-limit evaluate per-org to avoid accidental DoS. Return 429 when exceeded and show a small banner: "Preview temporarily unavailable".
Maya: Docs needed: short FAQ on "Why does the app show a different value?" and an article on anchoring semantics + audit traces.
Priya: Security: ensure audit log records who initiated an anchor and justification. Also add a guard: only org-admins and defined roles can anchor by default.
Zhen: Implementation checklist: evaluator endpoint, per-field provenance model, caching + memo keys, telemetry events + sampling, console badges + modal, audit write path for anchors, runbook + alerts.
Maya: Timeline idea: evaluator PoC by Friday, console badges PR week after, canary for internal orgs start in two weeks.
Alex: I'll take the evaluator PR, Zhen will do caching + provenance, Priya will own telemetry + alerting, Maya will own the console UX and docs.
ops-bot: deploybot: shadow-eval canary verify completed at 2024-05-20T09:40:03Z  se-dpl-987  status: healthy
Maya: Thanks all. We'll reconvene here if support volume doesn't drop after canary. :rocket:
